<function name="SetControlPointEntity" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets an entity to given control point for particle to use.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="cpID" type="number">The control point ID, 0 to 63.</arg>
		<arg name="parent" type="Entity">The entity to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
